completion_code:
if self.pending then
        return
    end

    if not self.ads:isRewardedReady() then
        self.ui:showMessage('Rewarded ad is not ready.')
        return
    end

    local request = { rewarded = false }
    self.pending = request
    self.ui:setRewardButtonEnabled(false)

    local finished = false
    local function finish()
        if finished then
            return false
        end
        finished = true
        if self.pending == request then
            self.pending = nil
            self.ui:setRewardButtonEnabled(true)
        end
        return true
    end

    local ok, accepted = pcall(function()
        return self.ads:showRewarded({
            onReward = function(reward)
                if self.pending ~= request or request.rewarded then
                    return
                end
                if reward.type ~= 'coins' or reward.amount ~= 50 then
                    return
                end
                request.rewarded = true
                self.player:addCoins(50)
                self.ui:showRewardGranted(50)
            end,
            onClosed = function()
                if not finish() then
                    return
                end
                if not request.rewarded then
                    self.ui:showMessage('Watch the full ad to receive the reward.')
                end
            end,
            onFailed = function()
                if finish() then
                    self.ui:showMessage('The ad could not be displayed.')
                end
            end,
        })
    end)

    if not ok or not accepted then
        if finish() then
            self.ui:showMessage('The ad could not be started.')
        end
    end
end
callback_handling: The request object identifies the active attempt, while a per-request flag prevents duplicate reward callbacks. The SDK contract delivers an earned reward before close; failure, close without reward, and rejected requests each restore the UI without granting coins.
invocation_timing: Invoke the handler from the player's explicit tap on the reward button. Check ad readiness before creating a pending request, disable the button during the request, and re-enable it when the ad closes or the request fails.
completion_instruction: Complete the reward-button handler. Start a rewarded ad only when it is ready and no request is already pending. Grant 50 coins only for the expected confirmed reward callback, and restore the button state on close, failure, or a rejected request.
reward_state_transition: Add 50 coins to the player only when the active request receives the confirmed coins reward with the expected amount. Closing without that callback leaves the balance unchanged.
